# BlogCategory ## Summary A content category with a display name, `shortName` for pills, a description, and a pill color. The exported `categoryStyle` helper derives the pill's text color from the background via `getContrastColor`, so any pill color stays readable. ## Import ```js import { BlogCategory, categoryStyle } from '../blog-category'; ``` ## Usage ```handlebars
{{category.shortName}}
```
